components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-conviction primary CTA button in Equator Crimson (#8B0000).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #8B0000; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 12px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, transform 0.1s; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #A00000; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.95); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Matched-hue status tag with static status dot indicator.
components.css: .ds-badge-confirmed { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; background: #EFF6FF; color: #1D4ED8; border: 1px solid #DBEAFE; } .ds-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #1D4ED8; }

components.name: Size Cell Input
components.description: Footwear size matrix numeric input with active crimson highlight and tabular numerals.
components.css: .ds-size-input { width: 48px; text-align: center; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; padding: 6px 4px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid #8B0000; background: #FEF2F2; color: #8B0000; outline: none; font-feature-settings: 'tnum' 1; }

components.name: CRT Terminal Print Frame
components.description: 80-column ESC/P dot-matrix phosphor green terminal emulator.
components.css: .ds-terminal { background: #091510; color: #34d399; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; padding: 16px; border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid #064e3b; overflow-x: auto; }

narrative.overview: MyEquator's visual identity reflects the physical, tactile world of footwear insole manufacturing in Bandung, West Java. It blends rugged industrial reliability with modern digital precision: deep vulcanized crimson (#8B0000), structured sizing breakdown matrices, high-contrast monospace ESC/P dot-matrix emulators, and crisp mechanical affordances.
keyCharacteristics: Crimson Brand Dominance: Dark Red (#8B0000) reserved for high-conviction actions and active indicators.
Physical Matrix Ergonomics: Tabular footwear size grids (EU 36-48) with auto-summed row/column totals.
Industrial Terminal Evocation: High-contrast 80-column CRT phosphor green previews simulating LX-310 continuous tractor-feed forms.
High-Assurance Safety: Non-blocking in-app confirmation dialogs and isDirty unsaved changes tracking.

rules.name: The Singular Accent Rule
rules.body: Deep crimson (#8B0000) is used on <=10% of any view. Its rarity is what gives it authority.

rules.name: The Matched Hue Rule
rules.body: Status badges always pair text and background from the same color family.

rules.name: The Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: All dynamic numbers, footwear sizes, currency amounts, and order codes must specify tabular-nums or font-mono with OpenType tnum enabled.

rules.name: The Inset Indicator Rule
rules.body: Active list items use an inset indicator bar rather than a thick left border, completely preventing box-sizing displacement.

rules.name: The Density Scale Rule
rules.body: The UI supports 5 granular font-size scaling tiers (xs: 12.5px to xl: 20.5px) controlled at :root for cross-operator visual comfort.

dos: Do format all currency in Indonesian Rupiah with thousand-separator dots: Rp 1.250.000.
Do include Indonesian Terbilang spelled-out text on printable Delivery Orders and Invoices.
Do use tabular-nums on all footwear quantities, sizes, prices, and dates.
Do ensure all mobile action buttons satisfy minimum 44px touch targets.
Do guard multi-field forms against accidental loss with isDirty discard confirmations.
donts: Don't use generic floating decorative gradients or rainbow AI accents.
Don't place dark gray text on saturated background colors (gray-on-color).
Don't use native browser alert() or window.confirm() popups; use accessible in-app modals.
Don't use pulse/ping animations on status badges; keep status indicators calm and static.
Don't apply border-left-4 on list cards; use inset indicator bars to avoid layout shifts.
